blocking_issues: The geometric covariance spectrum is removed before the SVD. design_matrix multiplies latent Gaussian columns by the declared scales, then standardize_train divides each column by its own ddof=0 standard deviation. A positive scale cancels exactly, so the isotropic and geometric matrices decomposed on one draw are identical, condition_number at p = n is identical, and the predeclared relative condition gap is zero on every draw. The geometric arm still changes the teacher inner product, so its risk contrast is a signal-strength change rather than a covariance intervention separate from noise.
